summary: Challis NF ground site in Custer County, ID at 10,736 ft; a c.1939 cabin or tent (sources disagree), abandoned in the 1950s and listed as gone.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone on firelookout.com and the Forest Fire Lookout Association list; no removal date or present condition found

staffing.status: listed in early-1940s Challis station tables

visit.trail_note: Idaho Fire Lookouts tags the site as hike-in

events.note: Cabin on the east point per firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts; a 24x24-foot framed tent per Forest Lookouts. Sources disagree; see resolved_conflicts
Listed among Challis NF station names in early-1940s staff tables (in the silo.tips text the name sits under the 1940 year heading, with a second listing under 1942; layout is hard to read)
Forest Lookouts dates abandonment to the 1950s; the year given here is the decade start

evidence.supports: location: Custer County, Idaho; Challis National Forest
1939 cabin atop east point, now gone

evidence.quote: The lookout site consisted of a 24'x24' framed tent.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts describe a cabin on the east point (c.1939); Forest Lookouts says the site consisted of a 24x24-foot framed tent. Not reconciled, so no design fact is set

notes_for_editor: Build date of c.1939 agrees across three listings, but structure type conflicts (cabin vs framed tent). Forest Lookouts attributes its 1950s abandonment to a source it names only as Kresek. The 1940 and 1942 station listings come from a silo.tips copy of a Challis NF history compilation; the table layout is hard to read, so it is cited only for the station name appearing in early-1940s tables, not for who staffed it. Idaho Fire Lookouts reports no documented staffing history, which is not contradicted, just not filled in. No photo found.
